kcrash.cause: The Debian 6.30 technical-reference packaging requested debhelper-compat (= 14), while the Ubuntu 26.04 Resolute provider used by the clean build does not satisfy compatibility level 14. The same install-deps failure affected four independent nodes, so it is classified as a shared packaging-tooling/provider incompatibility rather than a node-owned package FAIL.

infrastructure_incidents.cause: All four clean builds converged on unsatisfied debhelper-compat (= 14) before compilation.
infrastructure_incidents.remediation: Rematerialize the SupraLINUX package trees with an explicit Ubuntu Resolute packaging-tooling adaptation to debhelper compatibility level 13, without changing the KDE upstream feature profile, then repeat clean builds.

infrastructure_incidents.cause: The campaign pinned libkf6i18n-data as 3df2300d5aca640c8968859367ac3cd606a31e87e875ca207a71eeda6d03f45a, while retained KI18n artifact 10553916882 contains 3df2300d5aca640c8968859367ac3cd606a31a87e875ca207a71eeda6d03f45a.
infrastructure_incidents.remediation: Correct the campaign pin to the SHA-256 verified from the retained artifact before the next clean-build campaign.

note: Crossing the sbuild boundary records a real execution. Canonical FAIL still requires a node-owned root cause; shared infrastructure/provider failures remain INFRA with package_state_effect=none. Pre-sbuild failures are infrastructure incidents, not real package attempts.
